comments.body:
Thanks for your contribution, @pcbeingused333

You were right: Gemini thinking tokens weren't being billed. We're superseding this with #10280. It takes the same Gemini fix, also covers xAI (its `completion_tokens` leaves out reasoning too), and moves the rule into each provider's usage reader.

Recorded output token counts, metrics and traces now include reasoning as well as the cost. Much appreciated 🙏
